svg.text: One-on-one message: User A → chat server → queue → User B (online or offline)

g.text: User A sends a message over their WebSocket
Chat server gets a sortable message ID
Message goes into B's message sync queue
It is also persisted to the key-value store
Is B online? Presence knows from heartbeats
B is online → delivered over B's WebSocket instantly
(If B were offline, a push notification is sent instead)
